strategy.thesis: Single-LP, founder-friendly multi-stage VC backed entirely by Eyal Ofer's Ofer Global. Invests in early-growth-stage technology startups with strong product-market fit, typically at B and C rounds.

summary.en: O.G. Venture Partners (O.G. Tech) is the single-LP venture vehicle of Eyal Ofer's Ofer Global family office, headquartered in Tel Aviv. Launched in 2017 with a $100M (later $150M) fund and a $400M second fund in 2022, it backs early-growth-stage (Series B/C) Israeli and US tech companies with $5M–$15M initial checks.

strategy.thesis: The Israel investment arm of the Stephen Bronfman Family Office (Claridge Inc.) and CDPQ, focused on late-stage growth investments in Israel-related companies with a technological advantage. Differentiated by a family-office mindset and long-term horizon.

summary.en: Claridge Israel is the Israel-focused venture/growth investment arm of the Stephen Bronfman Family Office (Claridge Inc.), established in 2015 in partnership with CDPQ and later the Wener and Bensadoun families. Based in Ra'anana, it makes minority or majority growth-stage investments of $10M–$40M and has invested more than $800M in Israel over twenty years.

strategy.thesis: The technology investment arm of the single family office of Israeli billionaire Morris Kahn (founder of Amdocs and Golden Pages). Active in healthcare, life science and technology, alongside real estate and capital markets, with a long-term horizon.

summary.en: Aurum Ventures MKI is the technology and venture investment arm of Aurum, the single family office of Israeli billionaire Morris Kahn (founder of Amdocs and Golden Pages). Founded in 2005 and based in Ramat Gan, it focuses on healthcare, life-science and technology companies with checks reported in the $3M–$55M range, and has made roughly 47 investments.

Invests in socially responsible, disruptive technology — 'Founder First', 'Transformational Technology', 'Profit with Purpose'.

summary.en: Dynamic Loop Capital is the early-stage venture vehicle of Sir Ronald Cohen's family office, based in Tel Aviv. It invests capital from the 'father of European venture capital and impact investing' into socially responsible, disruptive technology across health, fintech, proptech, mobility, AI and beyond, backing founders early with follow-on support.

summary.en: Atooro Fund is the family venture-capital vehicle of Israeli businessman Jacob Engel, based at the Azrieli Center in Tel Aviv and founded in 2016. It backs seed/early-stage deep-tech in agri-foodtech, quantum computing, space commercialization, perceptual computing, AI and cyber-security, with checks of $500K–$5M (~$1M sweet spot).

summary.en: GlenRock Israel is the single family office of Leon Recanati, founded in 2003 and headquartered in Herzliya. It invests in technology and life-science companies, taking an active development role; notable holdings include Outbrain, Evogene, Kamada and Rainbow Medical.

strategy.thesis: A family venture vehicle of the Recanati family (Daniel Recanati) investing in pre-seed and seed-stage companies across deep tech, space, AI for Good, climate, fintech and consumer innovation, with over two decades in the global innovation ecosystem.

summary.en: Rhodium is the family venture vehicle of Daniel Recanati, founded in 2007 and based in Tel Aviv. It invests at pre-seed and seed across deep tech, space, AI, climate, fintech and consumer, with checks of $50K–$5M (~$500K sweet spot). Its track record cites 12 exits, 5 active unicorns and ~$10B of value generated; holdings include eToro, Outbrain, StoreDot, Yotpo and Face.com.

strategy.thesis: The single family office of Ruthi Wertheimer, managing capital from the family's 2006 sale of IMC Group to Berkshire Hathaway. Seeks long-term minority partnerships in mid-size industrial and life-science companies globally, including direct co-investments and SPVs, and is active in Israel's venture sector.

summary.en: 7-Main is the single family office of Ruthi Wertheimer, headquartered in Herzliya and founded in 2007 to manage capital from the family's 2006 sale of IMC Group to Berkshire Hathaway. It seeks long-term minority partnerships in mid-size industrial and life-science companies globally via direct co-investments and SPVs, and is one of Israel's most venture-active family offices.
